title: Fast walkers exempt from FOIA; Defense Support Program detections

tellings.quote: you to this day you cannot use the freedom of information act on fast walkers. You know uh John Greenwald tried to do that.

plain: Records of "fast walkers", fast-moving objects picked up by the Defense Support Program, a set of American early-warning satellites high above the Earth, are said to be off limits to FOIA, a US law that lets anyone request government records. Michels says this himself, adding that a records researcher named John Greenewald Jr. tried to get them that way. If true, it would mean satellite detections of unknown objects stay shut away from the public even today.
